purpose.en: Prepare a response plan with purpose, permission, an open question and a support contact before the conversation starts.
purpose.fil: Bumuo ng planong may layunin, pahintulot, bukas na tanong at contact para sa tulong bago magsimula ang usapan.

group_size.en: Triads (BHW, resident, observer); rotate over three rounds.
group_size.fil: Tatluhan (BHW, residente, tagamasid); magpalit sa tatlong round.

materials.en: Job aid: A respectful conversation, with local contacts filled in
materials.fil: Job aid: Magalang na pakikipag-usap, may nakasulat nang lokal na contact

steps.en: Read Rosa's case aloud and model the dialogue with a co-facilitator.
steps.fil: Basahin nang malakas ang kaso ni Rosa at imodelo ang usapan kasama ang co-facilitator.

steps.en: Ask the first check before revealing any feedback.
steps.fil: Itanong ang unang check bago ibigay ang anumang feedback.

steps.en: Each BHW player writes the four plan elements, then tries them with the resident, who may ask for another time.
steps.fil: Isusulat ng gumaganap na BHW ang apat na bahagi ng plano, saka susubukan sa residente, na puwedeng humiling ng ibang oras.

steps.en: Observer gives one strength and one action to try again; rotate roles.
steps.fil: Magbibigay ang tagamasid ng isang kalakasan at isang susubukang muli; magpalit ng papel.

steps.en: Repeat the part needing improvement, with the resident changing the wording.
steps.fil: Ulitin ang bahaging kailangang pagbutihin, na iniiba ng residente ang salita.

debrief.en: What was Rosa's concern, and how did we find out?
debrief.fil: Ano ang alalahanin ni Rosa, at paano natin ito nalaman?

debrief.en: Which words helped? What should happen next?
debrief.fil: Aling salita ang nakatulong? Ano ang susunod na dapat mangyari?

observe.en: Shows four plan elements: purpose, permission, an open question and a support route, without guessing Rosa's motive.
observe.fil: Ipinapakita ang apat na bahagi ng plano: layunin, pahintulot, bukas na tanong at paraan ng paghingi ng tulong. Walang hula sa motibo ni Rosa.

observe.en: Not yet if the plan finishes the form before permission or labels Rosa as unwilling to cooperate.
observe.fil: Hindi pa kung tatapusin ang form bago ang pahintulot o tinatawag si Rosa na ayaw sumunod.

output.en: One written plan per learner, with the agreed return time if Rosa asked for one.
output.fil: Isang nakasulat na plano bawat kalahok, may napagkasunduang oras ng pagbalik kung humiling si Rosa.

alternative.en: Alone or without printing: say the plan aloud to one colleague or record a fictional response, then arrange staff observation.
alternative.fil: Mag-isa o walang printer: sabihin nang malakas ang plano sa isang katrabaho o i-record ang kathang-isip na tugon, saka ayusin ang staff observation.

purpose.en: Practise a calm voice, an open question, a summary and an invitation to correct it when a resident is upset.
purpose.fil: Sanayin ang mahinahong boses, bukas na tanong, pagbubuod at paghingi ng pagwawasto kapag galit ang residente.

group_size.en: Triads (Jun, Liza, observer); rotate over three rounds.
group_size.fil: Tatluhan (Jun, Liza, tagamasid); magpalit sa tatlong round.

materials.en: Job aid: A respectful conversation, with local contacts filled in
materials.fil: Job aid: Magalang na pakikipag-usap, may nakasulat nang lokal na contact

steps.en: Read Liza's case and model the dialogue, including offering a more private place.
steps.fil: Basahin ang kaso ni Liza at imodelo ang usapan, kasama ang pag-aalok ng mas pribadong lugar.

steps.en: Ask the first check before revealing feedback.
steps.fil: Itanong ang unang check bago ibigay ang feedback.

steps.en: Run the role-play: Jun asks about the concern, listens without interrupting, summarizes and asks "Have I understood correctly?"
steps.fil: Patakbuhin ang role-play: itatanong ni Jun ang alalahanin, makikinig nang hindi sumasabat, magbubuod at magtatanong ng "Tama po ba ang pagkaintindi ko?"

steps.en: Run the second check, then give a strength and one next action.
steps.fil: Patakbuhin ang ikalawang check, saka magbigay ng kalakasan at isang susunod na gagawin.

steps.en: Rotate roles and repeat; the resident changes the wording each round.
steps.fil: Magpalit ng papel at ulitin; iniiba ng residente ang salita bawat round.

debrief.en: What did Jun learn only after summarizing?
debrief.fil: Ano ang nalaman ni Jun pagkatapos lamang magbuod?

debrief.en: What made it hard not to interrupt or promise something?
debrief.fil: Ano ang nagpahirap na huwag sumabat o mangako?

observe.en: Uses a calm voice and an open question, lets Liza finish, summarizes her reply and invites correction.
observe.fil: Gumagamit ng mahinahong boses at bukas na tanong, hinahayaang matapos si Liza, ibinubuod ang sagot at humihingi ng pagwawasto.

observe.en: Not yet if the learner interrupts, blames Liza or promises an outcome before hearing the concern.
observe.fil: Hindi pa kung sumasabat, sinisisi si Liza o nangangako bago marinig ang alalahanin.

output.en: The learner's summary sentence, written by the observer word for word.
output.fil: Ang pangungusap ng pagbubuod ng kalahok, isinulat ng tagamasid nang eksakto.

alternative.en: With few staff: run one fishbowl demonstration, then pairs; staff rate one learner at a time and schedule the rest at follow-up.
alternative.fil: Kung kaunti ang staff: magpakita ng isang fishbowl demonstration, saka pares; isa-isang ire-rate ng staff at iiskedyul ang iba sa follow-up.

purpose.en: Offer realistic options and confirm the chosen action, who will act and when, without promising an unconfirmed appointment.
purpose.fil: Mag-alok ng makatotohanang pagpipilian at kumpirmahin ang napiling hakbang, sino ang kikilos at kailan, nang hindi nangangako ng appointment na hindi pa kumpirmado.

group_size.en: Triads (Salma, Ben, observer); rotate over three rounds.
group_size.fil: Tatluhan (Salma, Ben, tagamasid); magpalit sa tatlong round.

materials.en: Job aid: A respectful conversation, with local contacts filled in
materials.fil: Job aid: Magalang na pakikipag-usap, may nakasulat nang lokal na contact

steps.en: Read Ben's case and model the dialogue, stating clearly that the schedule is not yet confirmed.
steps.fil: Basahin ang kaso ni Ben at imodelo ang usapan, malinaw na sinasabing hindi pa kumpirmado ang iskedyul.

steps.en: Ask the first check before revealing feedback.
steps.fil: Itanong ang unang check bago ibigay ang feedback.

steps.en: The BHW player offers two realistic follow-up options and asks which Ben prefers; Ben may decline one.
steps.fil: Mag-aalok ang gumaganap na BHW ng dalawang makatotohanang paraan ng follow-up at itatanong kung alin ang nais ni Ben; puwedeng tanggihan ni Ben ang isa.

steps.en: The BHW fills in the action card and asks Ben to repeat the agreement.
steps.fil: Pupunan ng BHW ang action card at ipauulit kay Ben ang napagkasunduan.

steps.en: Run the second check; give a strength and one next action; rotate.
steps.fil: Patakbuhin ang ikalawang check; magbigay ng kalakasan at isang susunod na gagawin; magpalit.

debrief.en: What is the difference between an update call and an appointment?
debrief.fil: Ano ang pagkakaiba ng update na tawag at appointment?

debrief.en: What would you do if no suitable option exists? (Ask the midwife or supervisor.)
debrief.fil: Ano ang gagawin kung walang angkop na pagpipilian? (Humingi ng gabay sa midwife o supervisor.)

observe.en: Records the chosen action, responsible person and time; confirms Ben's choice without presenting an update as an appointment.
observe.fil: Itinatala ang piniling hakbang, taong kikilos at oras; kinukumpirma ang pagpili ni Ben at hindi tinatawag na appointment ang update.

observe.en: Not yet if the learner promises an unconfirmed appointment or insists on an option Ben declined.
observe.fil: Hindi pa kung nangangako ng appointment na hindi pa kumpirmado o ipinipilit ang pagpiling ayaw ni Ben.

output.en: One completed action card per learner.
output.fil: Isang napunang action card bawat kalahok.

alternative.en: Without printing: draw three boxes on paper (action / who / when). Alone: record a fictional response, then arrange staff observation.
alternative.fil: Walang printer: gumuhit ng tatlong kahon sa papel (hakbang / sino / kailan). Mag-isa: i-record ang kathang-isip na tugon, saka ayusin ang staff observation.

worksheet.en: Action / who acts / when we update
worksheet.fil: Hakbang / sino ang kikilos / kailan magbabalitaan

purpose.en: Write a short factual handover to the authorized colleague and choose one specific improvement to one's own response.
purpose.fil: Sumulat ng maikli at factual na handover sa awtorisadong katrabaho at pumili ng isang tiyak na pagpapabuti sa sariling tugon.

group_size.en: Triads (Datu, midwife receiving the handover, observer); rotate over three rounds.
group_size.fil: Tatluhan (Datu, midwife na tatanggap ng handover, tagamasid); magpalit sa tatlong round.

materials.en: Job aid: A respectful conversation, with local contacts filled in
materials.fil: Job aid: Magalang na pakikipag-usap, may nakasulat nang lokal na contact

steps.en: Read Elena's case and model a three-line handover that does not label her.
steps.fil: Basahin ang kaso ni Elena at imodelo ang tatlong linyang handover na walang bansag.

steps.en: Ask the first check before revealing feedback.
steps.fil: Itanong ang unang check bago ibigay ang feedback.

steps.en: Each learner writes a three-line handover: what she said, what was done, the next step.
steps.fil: Susulat ang bawat kalahok ng tatlong linyang handover: sinabi niya, ginawa, susunod na hakbang.

steps.en: A partner checks for assumptions, labels or unnecessary details; the learner hands over aloud to the 'midwife'.
steps.fil: Susuriin ng kapareha kung may hula, bansag o hindi kailangang detalye; iaabot ito nang pasalita sa 'midwife'.

steps.en: Each learner names one change for next time; run the second check.
steps.fil: Magbabanggit ang bawat isa ng isang babaguhin sa susunod; patakbuhin ang ikalawang check.

debrief.en: Who needs to know this, and through which channel?
debrief.fil: Sino ang kailangang makaalam nito, at saang paraan?

debrief.en: What will you change in your next conversation, and how will you check it worked?
debrief.fil: Ano ang babaguhin ninyo sa susunod na usapan, at paano ninyo malalaman kung nakatulong?

observe.en: Separates Elena's question from assumptions, names the appropriate recipient, records the agreement and chooses one specific improvement.
observe.fil: Inihihiwalay ang tanong ni Elena sa hula, pinapangalanan ang tamang tatanggap, itinatala ang kasunduan at pumipili ng isang tiyak na pagpapabuti.

observe.en: Not yet if the handover adds assumptions or labels, or shares the story with people who do not need it.
observe.fil: Hindi pa kung may hula o bansag ang handover, o ibinabahagi ang kuwento sa hindi kailangang makaalam.

output.en: One three-line handover and one written improvement per learner (fictional details only).
output.fil: Isang tatlong linyang handover at isang nakasulat na pagpapabuti bawat kalahok (kathang-isip na detalye lamang).

alternative.en: Alone: write the handover and reflection, then read it to the midwife at the 2–4 week follow-up practice for observation.
alternative.fil: Mag-isa: isulat ang handover at pagninilay, saka basahin sa midwife sa follow-up practice sa loob ng 2–4 na linggo para maobserbahan.

worksheet.en: One thing I will change next time
